newsitem.title: INDONESIA: ASEAN cocoa producers to meet in Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: ASEAN cocoa producers to meet in Indonesia.

text.p: Southeast Asian cocoa producers will meet in Jakarta next week to discuss setting up a regional cartel to help protect them from global price volatility, industry sources said on Friday.

Representatives from the countries in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) have been invited to the two-day meeting starting on Tuesday. ASEAN links Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.
"Producers from the private sector and government officials from all ASEAN members have been invited to attend the meeting," an official from the ASEAN secretariat told Reuters.

Industry sources said the move to set up a "Single ASEAN Contract" was aimed at boosting the bargaining power of regional producers by offering similar quality cocoa to overseas' buyers at the same price.
But they added that the project was in its formative stage, and only Malaysia and the Philippines had expressed an interest while Indonesia was undecided.
Malaysia proposed and was coordinating the project. Indonesia is the world's third largest cocoa producer after the Ivory Coast and Ghana.
